title: App shell mounting, theming and screen lifecycle

claims.text: mountShell builds the header, primary navigation for agents, lineage, arena and ledger, the toolbar, fixture info, notice, main region and footer, then replaces the root children.
Theme selection prefers an explicit saved lineage-theme value, falls back to prefers-color-scheme, and persists only when the user activates a theme button.
viewState sets document title, aria-current navigation, busy state and diagnostics panels, and data-lin-rev only when a confirmed head exists.
An identity key collision lint finding disables every button, input and select in main and blocks screen readiness until resolved.

decision.rule: Change here when shell structure, theme persistence, screen readiness or focus management needs to change.
decision.failure: A screen stays not-ready, the theme flips on every visit, or focus is lost on navigation or refresh.

questions.q: Where does mountShell build the navigation and toolbar?
Where should I change theme persistence and the prefers-color-scheme fallback?
